actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry.

dimensions.assessment: Affects agricultural producers, researchers, rural communities, and students through updated grant priorities and technical assistance.
dimensions.evidence: rural communities, agribusinesses, farmers, and the food supply chain benefit from technical assistance, education, and outreach

dimensions.assessment: Expands the scope of existing Department of Agriculture programs to include artificial intelligence priorities without creating entirely new standalone funding allocations.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall designate a senior official from the National Institute of Food and Agriculture to serve as the Artificial Intelligence Agriculture Advisor.

dimensions.assessment: Integrates artificial intelligence into existing research and extension authorities without creating new spending authorizations.
dimensions.evidence: To increase access to artificial intelligence through programs of the Department of Agriculture, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Modifies multiple sections of agricultural research, extension, and workforce development statutes and creates a new designated advisor role.
dimensions.evidence: Subtitle C of the Department of Agriculture Reorganization Act of 1994... is amended by adding at the end the following new section

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory additions to agricultural research priorities and administrative leadership roles.
dimensions.evidence: research, development, and implementation of artificial intelligence to enhance precision agriculture, farm management

importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Department of Agriculture to incorporate artificial intelligence into existing research, grant, and extension programs and designates a senior official as an AI Advisor.
